item.title: Philadelphia 76ers exercise 2027-28 team option on VJ Edgecombe
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Philadelphia 76ers have exercised VJ Edgecombe’s third-year rookie scale option for the 2027-28 season

L'articolo Philadelphia 76ers exercise 2027-28 team option on VJ Edgecombe proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Philadelphia 76ers have exercised the third-year rookie scale option on VJ Edgecombe. His contract is now guaranteed through the 2027-28 season.

The No. 3 pick in the 2025 NBA Draft averaged 16.0 points, 5.6 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 1.4 steals while starting 75 games as a rookie.

Edgecombe was also a unanimous All-Rookie First Team selection and has quickly become one of Philadelphia’s key young pieces.

item.title: Phoenix Suns convert Drew Timme and Duop Reath to two-way deals
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Suns converted Drew Timme and Duop Reath to two-way deals while ending the contracts of C.J. Huntley and Koby Brea

L'articolo Phoenix Suns convert Drew Timme and Duop Reath to two-way deals proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Phoenix Suns have completed a series of moves involving their two-way roster spots. Drew Timme was claimed off waivers and converted to a two-way deal, while Duop Reath was also moved to a two-way contract.

Phoenix simultaneously terminated the two-way contracts of C.J. Huntley and Koby Brea, creating the necessary openings.

Timme and Reath will now occupy two-way spots and can also spend time with the Valley Suns in the G League.

L'articolo Phoenix Suns convert Drew Timme and Duop Reath to two-way deals proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Minnesota Timberwolves, Jaden McDaniels agrees to one-year, $40M extension
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
Jaden McDaniels has agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension with the Minnesota Timberwolves through the 2029-30 season

L'articolo Minnesota Timberwolves, Jaden McDaniels agrees to one-year, $40M extension proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
Jaden McDaniels and the Minnesota Timberwolves have agreed to a one-year, $40 million contract extension.
The new deal will keep the forward under contract through the 2029-30 season.

McDaniels was already signed to a long-term contract, but Minnesota has now added another season to the agreement.

The move reinforces his importance to the Timberwolves’ core after the franchise had also kept him off the table in trade discussions earlier this year.

L'articolo Minnesota Timberwolves, Jaden McDaniels agrees to one-year, $40M extension proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Dallas Mavericks waive Dwight Powell after 12 seasons
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Dallas Mavericks have waived Dwight Powell after 12 seasons and 763 games with the franchise

L'articolo Dallas Mavericks waive Dwight Powell after 12 seasons proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Dallas Mavericks have waived Dwight Powell, likely ending his 12-season run with the franchise. The Canadian big man was Dallas’ longest-tenured player.

Powell appeared in 763 games for the Mavericks, ranking fifth in franchise history in games played. He averaged 3.3 points and 4.1 rebounds last season.

“Dwight was the consummate professional throughout his 12 seasons with the Mavericks,” president of basketball operations Masai Ujiri said, also praising his impact on the Dallas community.

L'articolo Dallas Mavericks waive Dwight Powell after 12 seasons proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Memphis Grizzlies waive Walter Clayton Jr. and Micah Peavy
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Memphis Grizzlies have waived Walter Clayton Jr. and Micah Peavy ahead of the regular season

L'articolo Memphis Grizzlies waive Walter Clayton Jr. and Micah Peavy proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Memphis Grizzlies have waived Walter Clayton Jr. and Micah Peavy as they finalize their regular-season roster.
The move is especially notable for Clayton, the No. 18 pick in the 2025 NBA Draft.

Clayton joined Memphis from Utah in February and appeared in 24 games for the Grizzlies, averaging 9.7 points, 5.7 assists and 2.1 rebounds while shooting 36.6% from three.

Peavy, the No. 40 pick in 2025, played 61 games as a rookie with New Orleans, averaging 4.3 points and 1.9 rebounds.

L'articolo Memphis Grizzlies waive Walter Clayton Jr. and Micah Peavy proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Los Angeles Lakers waive Dalton Knecht
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Lakers have waived Dalton Knecht after unsuccessfully trying to trade him for frontcourt help

L'articolo Los Angeles Lakers waive Dalton Knecht proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Los Angeles Lakers have waived Dalton Knecht to get down to the 15-player roster limit. The team had tried to include him in a trade for another big man but could not find a deal.

Knecht was the No. 17 pick in the 2024 NBA Draft and averaged 9.1 points and 2.8 rebounds as a rookie. His role declined significantly last season.

JJ Redick recently explained that “the team changed, the needs changed, the fit changed,” foreshadowing Knecht’s difficult roster position.

L'articolo Los Angeles Lakers waive Dalton Knecht proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Brandon Miller, Hornets agree to five-year, $209M extension
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
Brandon Miller has agreed to a five-year, $209 million extension with the Charlotte Hornets

L'articolo Brandon Miller, Hornets agree to five-year, $209M extension proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
Brandon Miller and the Charlotte Hornets have agreed to a five-year, $209 million rookie-scale contract extension.
The deal secures one of the franchise’s key building blocks for the long term.

Miller is coming off the best season of his career, averaging 20.2 points and 4.9 rebounds while shooting 38.3% from three. Charlotte went 41-24 with him in the lineup and 3-14 without him.

The No. 2 pick in the 2023 NBA Draft is expected to take on an even bigger role following the departures of LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges.

L'articolo Brandon Miller, Hornets agree to five-year, $209M extension proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli visits Spurs practice, meets Victor Wembanyama ahead of Austin GP
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
Kimi Antonelli visited San Antonio Spurs practice and met Victor Wembanyama ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin

L'articolo Kimi Antonelli visits Spurs practice, meets Victor Wembanyama ahead of Austin GP proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
Kimi Antonelli visited a San Antonio Spurs practice and spent time talking with Victor Wembanyama and several players.
The Mercedes driver is in Texas ahead of this weekend’s United States Grand Prix in Austin.

Jared Weiss of The Athletic reported Antonelli’s appearance at the Spurs facility, providing an NBA-Formula 1 crossover during a crucial week for the Italian driver.

Antonelli currently leads the Formula 1 standings with 340 points, 102 ahead of teammate George Russell and 111 clear of Lewis Hamilton. Austin will give him his first mathematical opportunity to clinch the world championship.

L'articolo Kimi Antonelli visits Spurs practice, meets Victor Wembanyama ahead of Austin GP proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Houston Rockets convert Julian Phillips and Oscar Tshiebwe to two-way deals, waive Sean Pedulla
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Rockets converted Julian Phillips and Oscar Tshiebwe to two-way contracts and waived Sean Pedulla to create the needed roster spot

L'articolo Houston Rockets convert Julian Phillips and Oscar Tshiebwe to two-way deals, waive Sean Pedulla proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Houston Rockets have converted Julian Phillips and Oscar Tshiebwe to two-way contracts. Houston also waived Sean Pedulla to create the second two-way roster spot needed for both moves.

Phillips and Tshiebwe originally signed with Houston as free agents on July 24, 2026. Phillips, the No. 35 pick in the 2023 NBA Draft, has appeared in 167 NBA games, while Tshiebwe has played in 49.

With Pedulla waived, Houston is now down to 15 players on its standard roster while completing the moves needed to keep both Phillips and Tshiebwe on two-way contracts.

L'articolo Houston Rockets convert Julian Phillips and Oscar Tshiebwe to two-way deals, waive Sean Pedulla proviene da Sportando.

item.title: Phoenix Suns plan to convert Duop Reath to two-way contract
item.dc:creator: Alessandro Maggi
item.description:
The Phoenix Suns plan to convert Duop Reath to a two-way contract after three seasons with the Trail Blazers

L'articolo Phoenix Suns plan to convert Duop Reath to two-way contract proviene da Sportando.
item.content:encoded:
The Phoenix Suns plan to convert Duop Reath to a two-way contract. The big man joins Phoenix after spending three seasons with the Portland Trail Blazers.

According to Michael Scotto of HoopsHype, the Suns are set to keep Reath on a two-way deal for the upcoming season.

Reath averaged 6.2 points over his three seasons in Portland and adds depth to Phoenix’s frontcourt.

L'articolo Phoenix Suns plan to convert Duop Reath to two-way contract proviene da Sportando.
